Experience

Research, Leadership & Teaching

Research Intern — UTSI

University of Tennessee Space Institute · June 2026 – Present · Remote

Working under Dr. Esteban Cisneros-Garibay on computational fluid-structure interaction (FSI) simulation of bat flight. Extended and validated an existing FSI codebase, progressing from 2D flow models to full 3D flapping bat-wing simulations with membrane perforations.

  • Extended 2D flow + 1D filament model to 3D bat-wing with perforations
  • Debugged mesh inversion, fixed traction integral formulation, implemented Gaussian tip suppression
  • Validated against Blasius flat-plate analytical solution
  • Integrated energy-expenditure model (thermal balance, mechanical power)
  • Extracted wing-boundary from photographs for anatomically faithful meshes
  • Currently: two-way FSI coupling and leaky-filament boundary conditions

Co-Lead, Myoelectric Mechanical Team

Accessible Prosthetics Initiative, UMD · Member Fall 2025, Co-Lead Fall 2026 – Present

Leading a ~6-person mechanical subteam developing a myoelectric prosthetic hand that starts at the wrist. Coordinating with the electrical co-lead on motor control and EMG signal integration.

  • Designed preliminary housing and two-joint thumb mechanism in SolidWorks
  • Leading mechanical design decisions for the hand assembly
  • Coordinating design reviews across mechanical and electrical subteams

Note: Currently in the design phase — no working prototype yet.
